name: Tarek Sabha
occupation: Head of the Assembly (elected among clan elders)
residence: Assembly House, on the Citadel above the Great Court
daily_routine: morning inspection of the Great Court and Citadel gates
reviewing grain and brick allotments with Mara and Yara
visiting the Great Bath weekly for the purification rites
holding evening Assembly meetings with clan elders

goals.public_goal: Keep the town prosperous and its clans working in balance
goals.hidden_goal: Prevent open discussion of how close the town came to collapse during the Turning, to preserve unity
goals.deep_goal: Decide whether the town should be honest about its fragility or continue managing appearances

beliefs: The Citadel and the Great Bath are what hold this town's identity together
Some truths, spoken too plainly, do more harm than the problems themselves
A town survives because its people trust its leadership, even imperfectly
Unchecked curiosity about the Turning risks reopening wounds that finally closed
